name: Via 313 & Slackwater Pizzeria (Herriman / South Jordan / Draper) Cheese or Prosciutto Pizza
brandOrRestaurant: Via 313 Detroit Style Pizza / Slackwater Pizzeria (Herriman, South Jordan & Sandy/Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Via 313's airy, focaccia-like Detroit crust and Slackwater's thin artisan crust are fermented for easy digestibility and work well on steady days when ordered with simple cheese, turkey/chicken, or prosciutto.
prepOrOrderInstructions: At Via 313, order "The Detroiter" with cheese only (or light pepperoni) and light marinara stripes; at Slackwater, order a simple Margherita, Prosciutto, or Chicken pizza with a Lactaid.
watchOuts: Hold hot honey, jalapeños, and raw red onions
